explanation: Walk the list while redirecting each next pointer to the already reversed prefix. Save the old next pointer before changing it. Every returned node is an original node.
attribution: Original EPI Practice C# implementation, reusing and refining the repository-authored Blind75 algorithm fixtures. Collection membership follows Crackr; no external solution service is used.
correctness: The previous pointer heads the reversed processed prefix, and the current pointer heads the untouched suffix. Saving the original next node keeps the suffix reachable before redirecting the link. Each step moves one original node into the reversed prefix, so the final previous pointer is the required head without copied nodes.
walkthrough: For nodes [4,9,1], redirect 4 toward null, 9 toward 4, and 1 toward 9. The original node containing 1 becomes the head, giving [1,9,4].
edgeCases: One node remains linked to null.
All returned nodes must be the original nodes with unchanged values.
